messages:
Maya: heads-up — console invoice-preview for tenant 'velox' shows tokens double-counted after streaming session backfill. likely due to HTTP/2 multiplexing reusing request_id across frames.
Sam: wait, request_id reused? that's odd — we attach request_id at edge as UUID per request. can you paste example?
Maya: logs snippet: ```edge: {"req_id":"a1b2c3", "stream_id":"s-123", "frame":1} proxy: {"req_id":"a1b2c3", "frame":2} tally: {"req_id":"a1b2c3", "tenant":"velox", "tokens":350}``` looks like frame 2 treated as new request by tally-ing pipeline.
Ian: my guess: our session_key extraction from HTTP/2 HEADERS drops :stream-id in some proxies — we fallback to req_id. H2 multiplexing can reuse the same req_id across frames in the same connection, so dedupe-by-req_id fails for streaming routes.
Kelly: can reproduce on canary with `h2-multiplex=true`. Steps: 1) open streaming chat, 2) send two messages quickly, 3) run `select * from metering_events where req_id='a1b2c3'` — you'll see two events with same req_id but different token counts.
Maya: impact: invoice preview duplicates token counts in aggregate when dedupe key is req_id. only affects streaming routes and any routes with h2 proxy enabled. preview/invoice spikes look like real usage.
Sam: quick fix idea: change dedupe key to `req_id + frame_seq` or prefer `stream_id` if present. but requiring stream_id from upstream proxy is a rollout risk given varied proxies.
Ian: alternative in ingestion: `coalesce(stream_id, headers['x-stream-id'], null)` and if present prefer stream_id as the canonical session. fallback: ignore duplicate req_id occurrences within a 1s sliding window for routes marked streaming-mode.
Kelly: UX note — console rollouts currently toggle h2-multiplex per cluster. we should expose a metering-safe flag in route config: `emit_unique_req_ids=true|false` so teams can opt-in before we change dedupe. surface it in the route settings page with a tooltip.
Maya: +1. also need a migration plan for preview: mark suspected duplicates with `h2_dup=true` and run a dedupe/backfill job to collapse counts. @metering-bot can you kick a scan for affected tenants?
metering-bot: queued scan started. found 12 tenants with >1k duplicated events in last 7d. report: https://internal/redwood/meters/reports/h2-dup-171968 — will post results when done.
Sam: plan summary: 1) hotfix ingestion to prefer stream_id when present (canary), 2) add `emit_unique_req_ids` route flag in console, 3) schedule targeted backfill to fix previews, 4) add dashboard alert for per-route duplicate-rise >3x baseline.
Ian: i can ship a canary ingestion bump to proxy-canary today. need reviewers @Maya @Sam. also will add unit tests for dedupe logic and an e2e with h2 multiplex toggled.
Maya: reviewing now. also add a short note in rollout docs and set default `emit_unique_req_ids=false` to avoid surprises for existing customers.
Kelly: i'll author the ops runbook entry for oncall and the console tooltip copy. will include instructions to disable `emit_unique_req_ids` if duplicates spike.
Sam: ok i'll open the PR for ingestion change and the console flag. i'll reference the metering-bot scan in the issue. thx everyone.
_meta: generated by dataset generator for Redwood Inference; thread focuses on HTTP/2 multiplexing causing req_id dedupe issues in metering pipeline, and proposed fixes (ingestion changes, route flags, backfill, alerts).
